dialogues.speaker: Inga
dialogues.text: How long more will I be stuck with these chores... Tsk. How annoying.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are the Lightkeepers in charge of managing the docks as well?

dialogues.speaker: Inga
dialogues.text: Heh, it's a "really important job," you know!

dialogues.speaker: Inga
dialogues.text: They say the need to deal with endless details and tiny tasks in this job is perfect for building "the patience required of a Ratnik platoon leader." But, man... why does it feel like I'm trapped in one of those stories where the main character has to endure brutal training before they finally make it?

dialogues.speaker: Inga
dialogues.text: It's pretty clear I was sent here as punishment. They said I was too reckless during that last operation, and that's why Lauri got injured.

dialogues.speaker: Inga
dialogues.text: If you ask me, that was entirely his own fault... but never mind. I'll prove my worth the next time I'm in battle.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope you have a great day.

dialogues.speaker: Inga
dialogues.text: ...As if one could have a great day on a job like this.
